output_text: Native iOS SwiftUI Hotlympics face rating app. Features: rate face images, view leaderboards, upload photos, manage profile via tabs. Commands: open ios-app.xcodeproj; xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build; xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'; xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj. **Bundle ID** hotlympics.ios-app **Preferred Simulator** iPhone 16 Pro **Dependencies** Firebase Auth/Storage, Google Sign-In (SPM). After changes, build and fix warnings/errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator. **Main Entry** `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase setup, Google Sign-In URL schemes).
